Forces an explicit legal reckoning on executive control over press access.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confuses HOW disagreement is managed (institutional debate vs punitive exclusion), substituting censorship for discourse.

President Trump executes a Smart Selfish maneuver, manufacturing a grievance against critical outlets to project corruption onto the press while consolidating information control.

When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Punitive censorship erodes democratic feedback loops.

The Unavoidable Truth: A free press is essential to check executive overreach.

The Unavoidable Lie: Banning critical reporters restores journalistic integrity.

Kicking reporters out of the room doesn't make hard questions go away.

Actual Article Body:
WASHINGTON — President Trump said Friday that he was banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House due to what he called unfavorable coverage, and threatened that more such media prohibitions could be coming — offering his administration's latest test of constitutional First Amendment protections guaranteeing the freedom of the press.

Trump has long bristled at news coverage he maintains casts him in a negative light, and has a history of filing lawsuits against news organizations, while lashing out at individual reporters in person or over social media.

The move follows the president's decision, in February 2025, to keep Associated Press journalists out of the Oval Office, Air Force One and other events too small for a full press corps, in retaliation for the news outlet's decision not to follow his lead in changing the Gulf of Mexico's name.
